form.label: KO Version
form.description: Audit and recover dashboards, reports, and alerts by browsing the version history captured in index=ko_history.

search.query: | search label="$searchForDashboard$" OR title="$searchForDashboard$" owner="$selectUser$" | stats c by appName

condition.label: Views
condition.set: _time label title owner appName latestSharing latestMethod history

condition.label: Reports and alerts
condition.set: _time title type owner description actions email next_scheduled_time appName sharing latestMethod history alert.expires alert.severity

search.query: | search source IN ($koType$) | search label="$searchForDashboard$" OR title="$searchForDashboard$" appName IN ($selectApp$) owner="$selectUser$" latestMethod="$DeletedToken$" | stats c

panel.title: Count of active $data_type$ in Top 10 apps (unique titles)

search.query: | search source IN ($koType$) method!="delete" owner="$selectUser$" latestMethod="$DeletedToken$" | stats dc(title) as dc by appName | sort - dc | head 10
| search source IN ($koType$) owner="$selectUser$" | search latestMethod="DELETE" | stats c

table.title: $data_type$ — click a row to inspect version history

search.query: | search source IN ($koType$) | fillnull value=n/a | search label="$searchForDashboard$" OR title="$searchForDashboard$" appName IN ($selectApp$) owner="$selectUser$" latestMethod="$DeletedToken$" | sort - _time ```Combining email to and cc into one field``` | eval email='action.email.to'.if('action.email.cc'!="n/a",", ".'action.email.cc',"") | table $table_view$ ```Only showing next two scheduled times for reports``` | eval next_scheduled_time=mvindex(next_scheduled_time, 0,1) ``` shortening the history mv field``` | eventstats c(history) as count_all by title appName | eval _n=mvcount(history) | eval _oldest=mvindex(history,_n-1) | eval _oldest=if(match(_oldest,"- updated"),replace(_oldest,"updated","created"),_oldest) | eval _counter=if(_n>5,(_n-5)." more updates",null()) | eval history=case(_n=1, _oldest, _n<=5, mvappend(mvindex(history,0,_n-2),_oldest), 1==1, mvappend(mvindex(history,0,3),_counter,_oldest)) | eval method=case(count_all=1 AND match(method,"updated"), replace(method,"updated","created"),1==1, method) | eval latestMethod=case(count_all=1 AND match(latestMethod,"updated"), replace(latestMethod,"updated","created"),1==1, latestMethod) | fields - count_all _n _oldest _counter

table.title: Versions of "$drilldownTitle$" — click a row to diff

search.query: | head 1 | eval role="target" | table role _time data appName

panel.title: Textual diff — selected version vs previous
Visual diff — selected version vs previous

search.query: where _time<=$time$ | head 2 | streamstats count as n | eval role=if(n=1,"target","baseline") | table role _time data appName

panel.title: Hidden — drilldown source (raw XML extraction for diff panel)

search.query: index="ko_history" source IN ($koType$) title="$drilldownTitle$" | rex mode=sed "s/^.*?data=\"//" | rex mode=sed "s/\", type=views[\s\S]*//" | eval _raw=replace(_raw,"\\\\(.)","\1") | table _time _raw | sort - _time

panel.title: Hidden — drilldown source (clean data field for preview viz)

search.query: index="ko_history" source IN ($koType$) title="$drilldownTitle$" | eval data=replace(data,"\\\\(.)","\1") | table _time data appName | sort - _time

index="ko_history" source IN ($koType$) | rex field=uri "\/en-\w\w\/splunkd\/__raw\/servicesNS\/.*?\/(?<appName>.+?)\/" | rex field=uri "/servicesNS/.*?\/(?<appName>.*?)/data/ui/views/" | rex "(?<method>updated)" ```Removing URL-encoded characters from the file field``` | rex mode=sed field=file "s/%20/ /g" | rex mode=sed field=file "s/%3A/:/g" | rex mode=sed field=file "s/%21/!/g" | eval title = coalesce(title,file,dashboard), appName=coalesce(appName,app) | table now _time updated title config_type type sharing owner method source description appName actions action.email.message.alert action.email.to action.email.cc alert.expires alert.severity next_scheduled_time search data label userName | eval time=strftime(_time,"%F %T"), history=time." - ".method | stats latest(_time) as _time latest(method) as latestMethod latest(sharing) as latestSharing values(*) as * by title appName | search title=* | table _time updated title config_type type sharing latestSharing owner method latestMethod history source description appName actions action.email.message.alert action.email.to action.email.cc alert.expires alert.severity next_scheduled_time search data label userName
